summary: Aspect C (reasoning procedure): v08p with judgement.md rewritten as a fixed seven-item checklist (A real local change, B time course, C shape, D ST at matched heart rate, E position, F conduction, G noise), each given a FOR/AGAINST/NEUTRAL verdict, a list of non-evidence (signal quality, lead count, recurrence, K43) kept out of the findings, and probability bands set from the verdicts.
